name: Min Jung Gi
source:
Beumi gives personal assistance when Jung Gi is unable to investigate the stalker case due to an internal police station problem. Twelve years ago, Beumi has doubts about his father's death and is still wandering for clues.
[ Translator: [url=https://www.facebook.com/sophroniamoon888/]Sophronia Moon[/url] ]
